names.raid: The Yard raid and the Flood

lede: 30 September, Chicago time: the first whole day the tracker (rules 376) recorded, from the backup of 1 October. 17 people played; the peak was 12 online.
big: A day shaped by a one-off refund.1.78M of the 2.94M tickets that came in were the staff refund for Bom gear (rules 380), and the 1.87M spent at the Counter is most likely that refund being spent again. Without it, play paid in about 1.16M (kills 454k, selling 409k, quests 112k) and the regular sinks took about 1.38M (benches and projects 448k, the Gem Sorter 435k, outfitters 190k, the Store 165k). Hospital bills took 17k and the Exchange tax 111. Out ran in by about 315k, and the pile held fell by about as much (5.61M to 5.28M), so the tracker already roughly adds up; the casino paid players a net 44,254 over 127 plays. One day is one day: the next nightly backups will show a normal day.
